text.en:
There were two RCs this week. Detailed metagame shares and matchup win rates are available under the Tabletop Events tab. Although Mono-Green Broodscale did not win either RC, the most represented deck still posted excellent results, with a 53.8% win rate including draws. It also continues to lead the field on Magic Online.
Azorius Chant Control also performed well at the RCs, posting a 57.1% win rate. The deck also won this week's 344-player Super RCQ on Magic Online. Of the other three qualification spots, Mono-Green Broodscale took two and Izzet Prowess took the remaining one.
text.zh:
本周有两场RC，各类套牌占比、对阵胜率等详细数据可以在“实体大赛”标签中查看。两场RC上纯绿孳巢蜥虽然都没有席卷，但作为占比最高的套牌，依旧打出了非常出色的战绩（含平局胜率53.8%）。MO上也是继续一骑绝尘。
RC上蓝白吟颂控也表现出色，胜率达到57.1%。这套牌也席卷了本周MO上344人的超级RCQ。不过另外三个资格中有2个都被纯绿孳巢蜥拿到，另外一个是红蓝灵技。

text.en: Among the new FRA technology, [[card:Pompous Battlemage|Pompous Battlemage]], already used in Standard and Pioneer Prowess, also appears as a full playset in many Modern lists: deck:66a574998435c01d9534. A version replacing [[card:Monastery Swiftspear|Monastery Swiftspear]] reached the Top 8 of the Japan/Korea RC: deck:be06bd26bda6fb708dbb. For now, though, traditional builds remain more common.
text.zh: FRA新科技方面，标准先驱灵技都用上的[[card:Pompous Battlemage|浮夸战巫师]]，在摩登中也得到很多满编：deck:66a574998435c01d9534。日韩RC中也有一套替代了矛妹的版本打进八强：deck:be06bd26bda6fb708dbb。不过相比之下暂时还是传统构筑比较多。

text.en: Hall of Famer Shuhei Nakamura also made the RC Top 8 with Rakdos Delirium, running a full playset of [[card:Dark Matter Manipulator|Dark Matter Manipulator]] in place of former [[card:Stitcher's Supplier|Stitcher's Supplier]]: deck:2f3bb88642c119095bb1. This version is seeing some play on Magic Online too. The older build won an event this week, while the new version has yet to post a result.

text.en: Many [[card:Devoted Druid|Devoted Druid]] Combo lists run one or two [[card:Solarium Sentry|Solarium Sentry]] as hate cards against Storm, Burn, and similar decks. Being green makes it searchable with [[card:Green Sun's Zenith|Green Sun's Zenith]], a substantial improvement: deck:9124fda2b936a0f508a0. The Super RCQ Top 8 version has one [[card:Karn, Argent Defender|Karn, Argent Defender]] in the sideboard, offering a [[card:Torpor Orb|Torpor Orb]]-like effect that [[card:Nature's Rhythm|Nature's Rhythm]] can find: deck:c089ee20b271b059e4bf.
text.zh: 缓伤组合技套牌很多都带上了1-2张[[card:Solarium Sentry|沐日哨卫]]作为对风暴、烧等套牌的仇恨组件，沾绿能被绿阳找是不小的提升：deck:9124fda2b936a0f508a0。而在超级RCQ中打进八强的版本备牌带了一张[[card:Karn, Argent Defender|银白守卫像卡恩]]，是一个可以被韵律找出来的类[[card:Torpor Orb|迟钝法球]]效果：deck:c089ee20b271b059e4bf。
